outcome: International League of Associations for Rheumatology (ILAR) JIA categories
cohort: 1,234 JIA cases and 5,993 birth year-matched controls.
finding: Greater maternal parity was associated with a decreased odds ratio for JIA, while prior fetal loss was associated with an increased odds ratio for JIA; prematurity was associated with increased risk of enthesitis related arthritis and rheumatoid factor positive polyarticular JIA.
